Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text: PARAMS (JSON): action (required) + per-action keys. VERBS: init — OnLayoutEnter: SETTINGS__EnsureLoaded, then find + list refresh load — re-run find + list refresh from current settings filter — optional tip; persists invoices.currentType, then find + list refresh toggleType — toggle StatusDokumenta Račun/Predračun on current record + receipt number + list refresh togglePayment — cycle NacinPlacanja Gotovina → Virman → Kartica changeCompany — toggle invoices.currentCompany OD/DOO, then find + list refresh recalcList — list refresh only (INV__LoadLastInvoices worker) regeneratePDF — delegate to Process Invoice (UI), operation=regeneratePDF refund — delegate to Process Invoice (UI), operation=refund (dialog lives there) generate — delegate to Process Invoice (UI), operation=invoice/proforma from StatusDokumenta printOptions — open Card Invoice Print card window pickClient — open Card Odabir Klijenta card window setPaymentDate — validate Globals::DatumPlacanja, write DatumPlacanja, close popover removeProforma — clear PDFFile (unlocks), jump to generateProforma object proformaPopover — optional tip; set Globals::SelectedInvoiceType, list refresh, jump by fiscal state recalculateInvoiceValue — commit, recompute via INV__CalcInvoiceValue worker addNew — create header via INV__DodajRacun, then find the new record RETURNS: Response_Finalize envelope. Worker errors are absorbed via Response_Absorb. CONTEXT: must run on a layout anchored on I__INVOICES (record-bound verbs read the current record). Example button binding Perform Script [ Specified: From list ; “I__InvoicesDispatcher” ; Parameter: JSONSetElement ( "{}" ; "action" ; "toggleType" ; JSONString ) ]
